AI Image Online — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release: convert images or prompts into animated video clips online.
- Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF uploads up to 200MB; outputs 1080p MP4 files.
- Automatic setup with free cloud GPU processing (requires NEMO_TOKEN).
- Guides users through upload, editing, and export workflows with simple prompts.
- Includes robust error handling and clear feedback during all steps.
- Ideal for marketers, creators, and small businesses seeking fast promo video generation.
